sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game cutout rig source sheet. Inputs are STYLE/IDENTITY references only. Ink line and opaque gouache, high-detail grey dead-season fantasy. Draw ONLY named subject's SEPARATED PARTS for hierarchical animation, not assembled poses. All parts same 3/4 overhead facing screen-right, same scale/lighting; hidden areas and rounded overlapping joints fully drawn. Arrange parts in clean separated spacious grid on TRUE TRANSPARENT canvas 2048x2048, minimum 30px gaps. No shadows, scenery, labels, gridlines, numbers, colored guide marks. Each arm/leg points generally downward in neutral rest. Body and limbs must NOT be duplicated/connected. Preserve gritty high-quality source proportions and dark quiet palette; red reserved only later animated danger so remove red body markings. Subject: Image1 lower-middle armored six-legged beetle mite. Six separate slim armored insect legs (left/right front middle rear), shell/body with NO legs, separate head with mandibles.
